defs.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
defs.genInstructions: Build a full left-hand deck: spinning jog wheel/platter, track title/BPM/key readout, elapsed & remaining time, play/pause/cue/sync buttons, pitch fader, loop and hot-cue pads, and a scrolling waveform for the loaded track. It gives the DJ complete playback and beat control over channel A.
defs.role: The left playback engine that plays, cues and beat-manipulates channel A's track and reports its state to the mixer, waveform and effects rack.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user double-clicks a track row or presses 'Load to A', the browser emits the full track object (title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform data, file id) and Deck A loads it, resets playhead to 0:00, displays the metadata and redraws its waveform, without auto-playing.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When the rack is routed to deck A, its wet/dry, rate and effect-type parameters are applied to Deck A's audio; enabling a beat-synced effect reads Deck A's BPM to time the effect, and Deck A shows an FX-active indicator.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
effectors.description: The master panel's global SYNC/quantize setting and master BPM value are pushed to Deck A, which snaps its pitch/tempo and loop boundaries to the master grid when engaged.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
targets.description: Deck A continuously emits its post-fader audio level and play state to channel strip A, driving that strip's VU meter; the mixer's channel-A gain/EQ/filter and crossfader position in turn determine how much of Deck A's signal reaches master.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck A streams playhead position, tempo, beatgrid and loop region to the top waveform lane, which scrolls in sync and highlights active loop/cue markers; clicking or dragging in that lane seeks Deck A.

targets.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
targets.description: Deck A reports its current BPM and phase so the master panel can display beat-match/phase alignment against Deck B and compute master BPM when Deck A is the sync leader.

defs.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
defs.genInstructions: Build the mirrored right-hand deck with the same capabilities as Deck A: jog wheel, metadata readout, transport controls, pitch fader, hot cues, loops and its own waveform strip, so the DJ can prepare and mix the incoming track.
defs.role: The right playback engine that plays, cues and beat-manipulates channel B's track and reports its state to the mixer, waveform and effects rack.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: Pressing 'Load to B' or double-clicking with deck B focused sends the selected track object (title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform data) to Deck B, which loads it, resets the playhead, shows metadata and redraws its waveform.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When routed to deck B, the rack applies its effect type, wet/dry and beat-division parameters to Deck B's signal, reading Deck B's BPM for tempo-synced effects; Deck B lights its FX indicator.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
effectors.description: Master BPM and quantize/sync-leader settings are pushed to Deck B, which snaps its tempo and loop points to the master beatgrid when sync is engaged.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
targets.description: Deck B emits its audio level and play state to channel strip B for VU metering, while the mixer's channel-B gain/EQ/filter and crossfader position control how much of Deck B's signal is sent to master.

targets.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
targets.description: Deck B streams playhead position, tempo, beatgrid and loop region to the bottom waveform lane for synchronized scrolling and marker display; clicking or dragging that lane seeks Deck B.

targets.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
targets.description: Deck B reports BPM and beat phase so the master panel can show the beat-match/phase offset against Deck A and derive master BPM.

defs.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
defs.genInstructions: Build the center mixer: two channel strips (trim/gain, 3-band EQ, filter knob, cue/headphone toggle, vertical line fader, VU meter) plus a horizontal crossfader with curve control and headphone cue mix. This is where the DJ balances, EQs and blends both decks.
defs.role: The signal-blending hub that takes both decks' audio, shapes it per channel, and feeds the combined mix to the master output.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A sends its live output level and play state to channel strip A, which animates its VU meter and enables its fader/EQ controls for that signal.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B sends its live output level and play state to channel strip B, animating that strip's VU meter and arming its fader/EQ controls.

targets.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
targets.description: The mixer emits the summed post-fader, post-crossfader stereo level and clip flags to the master panel, which drives the master VU meters; the master volume/limiter then scales that summed signal for output.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Moving channel A's fader, gain, EQ bands or filter, or sliding the crossfader toward B, attenuates/colors Deck A's contribution and Deck A reflects the resulting audible level in its FX/level indicator.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Moving channel B's fader, gain, EQ bands or filter, or sliding the crossfader toward A, attenuates/colors Deck B's contribution and Deck B reflects the resulting audible level in its level indicator.

defs.name: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
defs.genInstructions: Build a wide top-of-screen dual scrolling waveform view with deck A above and deck B below, aligned beatgrids, cue/loop markers, a center playhead line, and zoom controls so the DJ can visually beat-match and scrub.
defs.role: The shared visual beat-matching surface that renders both decks' waveforms in alignment and lets the DJ scrub either deck.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A pushes playhead time, BPM/tempo, beatgrid markers, hot-cue points and active loop range; the top lane scrolls at the corresponding rate and draws those markers.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B pushes playhead time, tempo, beatgrid, cues and loop range; the bottom lane scrolls in alignment with the top lane for visual beat-matching.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Clicking or dragging horizontally within the top lane emits a seek-to-time command that moves Deck A's playhead to that position (quantized to the beat when quantize is on).

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Clicking or dragging within the bottom lane emits a seek-to-time command that repositions Deck B's playhead to the clicked timestamp.

defs.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
defs.genInstructions: Build a effects panel with selectable effect slots (echo, reverb, filter sweep, flanger, bit-crush), an A/B/Master routing selector, wet/dry and beat-division knobs, on/off pads and a large XY performance pad. It lets the DJ apply live processing to either deck or the master bus.
defs.role: The live performance processor that routes and applies real-time effects to the chosen deck or the master bus.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
effectors.description: The master panel supplies the current master BPM so beat-division knobs (1/4, 1/2, 1, 2 beats) compute effect times in milliseconds and stay tempo-locked.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: With routing set to A, toggling an effect on sends {effectType, wetDry, beatDivision, enabled} to Deck A, which processes its output accordingly and lights its FX-active indicator; turning it off clears the indicator.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: With routing set to B, the rack sends its active effect type and parameter values to Deck B, which applies them to its output and shows its FX-active indicator.

targets.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
targets.description: With routing set to Master, the rack applies its effect to the summed bus, and the master panel's VU meters reflect the processed level plus an FX-on-master badge.

defs.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
defs.genInstructions: Build a browsable library panel: search field, crate/playlist sidebar, sortable track table (title, artist, BPM, key, length, rating), waveform preview, and explicit 'Load to A' / 'Load to B' buttons. It is how the DJ finds and loads music onto the decks.
defs.role: The track source of the system, feeding selected songs and their metadata into either deck.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Clicking 'Load to A' (or double-clicking a row with deck A focused) emits the selected track's full record — title, artist, BPM, key, duration, waveform data — and Deck A loads it, resets the playhead and displays the metadata.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Clicking 'Load to B' emits the selected track record to Deck B, which loads the audio, resets its playhead to zero and updates its title/BPM/key readouts.

defs.name: DJ Table: Master Output Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a compact master section with stereo master VU meters, master volume and limiter, booth level, master BPM readout with sync-leader selector, quantize toggle, beat-phase alignment meter between decks, and a recording button with elapsed time.
defs.role: The global output and timing authority that meters the final mix, sets master tempo/quantize for both decks, and handles recording.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer Console
effectors.description: The mixer streams the summed post-crossfader stereo level and clip flags, which drive the master VU meters and clip LEDs before master volume/limiter scaling.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A reports its BPM and beat phase, used for the master BPM readout when A is sync leader and for the phase-alignment meter.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B reports its BPM and beat phase, feeding the master BPM value when B is leader and the deck-vs-deck phase alignment meter.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When the rack routes to Master, the processed bus signal is metered here and an FX-on-master badge is shown.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Changing master BPM, sync leader or the quantize toggle pushes the new tempo/grid settings to Deck A, which adjusts its pitch to match and snaps cues/loops to the master grid while sync is on.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Master BPM, sync-leader and quantize changes are pushed to Deck B, which retunes its tempo to the master value and quantizes its loop and cue triggers.

targets.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
targets.description: The current master BPM is broadcast to the rack so its beat-division based effects recalculate their timing whenever master tempo changes.
